title: Samsung Unveils Galaxy Buds On with Hands‑Free AI Controls
dek: Samsung introduced the Galaxy Buds On, earbuds that use hands‑free AI controls and include other smart audio features.
body:
Samsung unveiled the Galaxy Buds On, a new pair of wireless earbuds that the company says include hands‑free AI controls and other smart features aimed at everyday use. "Hands‑free AI controls" refers to voice-activated or automatic functions powered by artificial intelligence (AI), software that can interpret user input and act without manual button presses.

## Why it matters

The announcement signals Samsung is continuing to add AI-driven features to consumer audio hardware. For buyers who prioritize voice-based control and automatic adjustments, these earbuds are being marketed as a product that reduces the need to touch the device during use. Beyond convenience, manufacturers often use integrated AI to personalize sound or manage connections, so the inclusion of hands‑free AI controls could affect how users interact with earbuds on a daily basis.

## The details

- Product name: Galaxy Buds On.
- Key billed feature: hands‑free AI controls — voice or AI-powered operation without manual input.
- Other attributes mentioned: smart features and enhanced sound quality.
- Source of information: Small Business Trends coverage of Samsung’s announcement.

What is not yet disclosed in the reporting: specific technical details and consumer-facing information remain unknown. The announcement summary does not include price, release date, battery life, wireless codec support, active noise cancellation capability, exact list of smart features, whether the AI processing runs locally on the earbuds or via a connected phone or cloud service, or regional availability.

## What to watch

Look for Samsung to publish full technical specifications and timing for sales. Also watch for reviews that test the hands‑free AI controls in real-world conditions and measure battery life and sound performance.

Source: [Small Business Trends](https://smallbiztrends.com/samsung-unveils-galaxy-buds-on-with-hands-free-ai-controls/)
